messages.subject: irace to PyImp (parameter importance analysis)
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I've made a small R script to convert irace Rdata file into the input format supported by PyPimp (https://github.com/automl/ParameterImportance), the parameter importance analysis tool that I've been using for sometime and find it useful. So I thought I would share the script here just in case anyone might find it useful!

The R script is here:
https://github.com/ndangtt/irace-to-pimp

Thanks,
Nguyen
